T: Adopt a kid. Feed him whatever he wants.
D: A lazy New Yorker adopts a five-year-old to win back his girlfriend and makes up the parenting rules as he goes.
P: Serve the wings when Sonny takes Julian out to the sports bar.
S: Crisp baked wings glazed in sticky barbecue sauce

Sticky smoky barbecue wings with a sweet heat glaze, scattered with spring onion and served with a cool ranch dip. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp hot sauce for 3 minutes and toss the wings through, then bake 5 minutes more. Mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and garlic powder for the ranch. Scatter wings with spring onion.
Mini bagels with cream cheese and everything seasoning

Toasted mini bagels with whipped spring onion cream cheese, crisp bacon and a sprinkle of homemade everything seasoning. Mix 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp poppy seeds, 1 tsp dried onion flakes, 1/2 tsp garlic flakes and 1/2 tsp sea salt. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 sliced spring onions until fluffy. Grill 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with the cream cheese, top with bacon and sprinkle with the seasoning.
M: Beef cheeseburgers with bacon, crinkle chips and onion rings

Smashed beef patties with melted cheese in toasted buns, with a build-your-own bar of pickles, bacon, onion rings, sauces and crinkle fries. Bake 800g frozen crinkle-cut chips and 300g frozen onion rings at 220C for 25 minutes. Grill 6 rashers bacon. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls, smash flat in a very hot oiled pan, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Set out lettuce, tomato, pickles, bacon, onion rings, tomato sauce, mustard and mayonnaise and let everyone build their own.
W: Blue jelly, vanilla ice cream, cream, biscuit sand and gummy fish

Vanilla ice cream with blue jelly cubes, whipped cream, crushed biscuit sand, gummy fish and chocolate sauce, an under-the-sea sundae. Make 1 packet blue jelly with 500ml boiling water, set in a shallow dish for 3 hours and cut into cubes. Crush 6 plain sweet biscuits into sand. In 4 tall glasses, layer jelly cubes, 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and more jelly. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, a sprinkle of biscuit sand, a few gummy fish and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.
K: Vanilla ice cream, milk, chocolate sauce and malt blended thick

Thick chocolate malt milkshakes with ice cream, whipped cream and a drizzle of chocolate sauce, served with striped straws. Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes and drizzle chocolate sauce down the insides. Blend 600ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp chocolate malt powder and 2 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and sprinkle with a little more malt powder.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss the wings in the baking powder mix and keep uncovered in the fridge up to 1 day ahead; mix the ranch up to 2 days ahead; bake and sauce on the night

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder, paprika and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey and hot sauce, toss the wings through and bake again.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chives and garlic powder for the ranch.
Scatter the wings with spring onion and serve with the ranch.

veg.n: Sonny's sports bar barbecue cauliflower bites
veg.make_ahead: Mix the ranch up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; the batter does not hold, so batter, bake and sauce the cauliflower on the night

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water, baking powder, paprika and salt into a batter and toss the cauliflower through it.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until golden.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey and hot sauce, toss the cauliflower through and bake again.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chives and garlic powder for the ranch.
Scatter the cauliflower with spring onion and serve with the ranch.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the seasoning up to 1 week ahead; beat the cream cheese and crisp the bacon up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; toast the bagels and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Mix the seeds, onion flakes, garlic flakes and salt for the seasoning.
Beat the cream cheese with the spring onions until fluffy.
Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with the cream cheese, top with bacon and sprinkle with the seasoning.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the seasoning up to 1 week ahead; beat the cream cheese and crisp the tofu up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; toast the bagels and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Mix the seeds, onion flakes, garlic flakes and salt for the seasoning.
Beat the cream cheese with the spring onions until fluffy.
Crumble the smoked tofu and fry in the oil until crisp.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with the cream cheese, top with the crisp tofu and sprinkle with the seasoning.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll the mince into balls up to 1 day ahead and prep the toppings up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; bake the chips and cook the burgers on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips and onion rings at 220C until crisp.
Grill the bacon.
Roll the mince into balls, smash flat in a very hot pan with the vegetable oil, season and cook, then flip and top with the cheddar.
Toast the buns.
Set out the lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, tomato sauce, mustard and mayonnaise and let everyone build their own.

veg.n: Tollbooth shift smashed mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Prep the lettuce, tomatoes and pickles up to 4 hours ahead and brush the mushrooms and haloumi with oil and paprika up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; cook everything on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips and onion rings at 220C until crisp.
Brush the mushrooms and haloumi with the oil and smoked paprika.
Cook the mushrooms in a very hot pan, smashing them flat with a spatula, then flip and top with the cheddar.
Fry the haloumi until golden on both sides and toast the buns.
Set out the lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, tomato sauce, mustard and mayonnaise and let everyone build their own.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and set the jelly up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cube it, whip the cream and build the sundaes on the night

steps.text: Make up the jelly with boiling water and pour into a shallow dish.
Set the jelly in the fridge, then cut into cubes.
Crush the biscuits into sand.
In tall glasses layer jelly cubes, ice cream and more jelly.
Top with whipped cream, biscuit sand, gummy fish and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Make and set the agar jelly up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cube it, whip the cream and build the sundaes on the night

ingredients.item: packet vegetarian blue jelly crystals (agar set)

steps.text: Make up the vegetarian jelly as the packet directs, bringing it to the boil, and pour into a shallow dish.
Set the jelly in the fridge, then cut into cubes.
Crush the biscuits into sand.
In tall glasses layer jelly cubes, ice cream and more jelly.
Top with whipped cream, biscuit sand, gummy lollies and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the glasses in the freezer and whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead; blend just before serving as the shake melts fast

ingredients.item: chocolate malt powder, plus extra to sprinkle

steps.text: Chill tall glasses in the freezer.
Drizzle chocolate sauce down the inside of each glass.
Blend the milk, ice cream, malt powder and cocoa until thick, then pour into the glasses.
Top with whipped cream and a sprinkle of malt powder.
